chosen_scenario_name.description: The name of the single best-fit scenario.
chosen_scenario_name.title: Chosen Scenario Name

justification.description: A comprehensive justification (100-150 words) for the chosen scenario. This text MUST explain *why* it's the best fit by explicitly referencing the plan's characteristics (ambition, risk, etc.) and why the other scenarios are less suitable. Use markdown bullet points for clarity.
justification.title: Justification

PlanCharacteristics.description: A structured analysis of the input plan's core nature.

ambition_and_scale.description: Analysis of the plan's level of ambition and its scale (e.g., personal, local, global, revolutionary).
ambition_and_scale.title: Ambition And Scale

risk_and_novelty.description: Assessment of the inherent risk and novelty. Is it a proven formula, an experimental pilot, or a groundbreaking endeavor?
risk_and_novelty.title: Risk And Novelty

complexity_and_constraints.description: Evaluation of the plan's operational complexity and stated constraints (e.g., budget, timeline, technical requirements).
complexity_and_constraints.title: Complexity And Constraints

domain_and_tone.description: The plan's subject matter and overall tone (e.g., corporate, scientific, personal, creative).
domain_and_tone.title: Domain And Tone

holistic_profile_of_the_plan.description: A concise, holistic summary synthesizing the above characteristics into a single profile of the plan's strategic intent.
holistic_profile_of_the_plan.title: Holistic Profile Of The Plan

PlanCharacteristics.title: PlanCharacteristics

ScenarioFitAssessment.description: An assessment of how well a single scenario fits the plan.

scenario_name.description: The name of the scenario being assessed.
scenario_name.title: Scenario Name

fit_score.description: A numerical score from 1 (poor fit) to 10 (perfect fit) indicating how well this scenario aligns with the plan's holistic profile.
fit_score.title: Fit Score

fit_assessment.description: A brief (1-2 sentences) rationale for the assigned fit score.
fit_assessment.title: Fit Assessment

ScenarioFitAssessment.title: ScenarioFitAssessment

scenario_assessments.description: An assessment for every single scenario provided.
scenario_assessments.title: Scenario Assessments
